en: A colorized historic postcard view of a large, fortress‑like barracks building with crenellated walls and several pointed towers on a street corner. To the left stands a massive round medieval tower with a conical roof. People walk along wide, mostly empty streets. The sky is softly tinted blue with scattered clouds, in a typical early 20th‑century postcard style. German text is printed at the top identifying the scene in Bautzen.
